definitions.explanation: The Buddhist concept that all things are transient and nothing remains unchanged. A fundamental idea in Japanese aesthetics and philosophy, closely tied to the appreciation of fleeting beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無常|むじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel the impermanence of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{散|ち}り→散る：02075_chiru⟧ゆく⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無常|むじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧ならで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧だ。
examples.english: Feeling impermanence in falling cherry blossoms is a sensibility unique to the Japanese.

examples.japanese: 「{祇園精舎|ぎおんしょうじゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧、⟦{諸行無常|しょぎょうむじょう}→諸行無常：14481_shogyoumujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{響|ひび}き→響き：00098_hibiki⟧あり」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、『{平家物語|へいけものがたり}』⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冒頭|ぼうとう}→冒頭：11725_boutou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: "The sound of the bells of Gion Shoja echoes the impermanence of all things" is famous as the opening of The Tale of the Heike.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{無常|むじょう} is one of the most important concepts in Japanese culture, originating from Buddhist philosophy. The idea that all phenomena are transient pervades Japanese literature, art, and aesthetics — from the opening of the {平家物語|へいけものがたり} (The Tale of the Heike) to the appreciation of ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry blossoms) precisely because they fall.

KEY EXPRESSION:
⟦{諸行無常|しょぎょうむじょう}→諸行無常：14481_shogyoumujou⟧ (all things are impermanent) is a core Buddhist teaching and one of the most widely known four-character idioms in Japanese.

RELATED WORDS:
- {無常|むじょう}{観|かん}: a worldview based on impermanence
- {無常|むじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: the "wind of impermanence" (poetic expression for death)
- ⟦{儚|はかな}い→儚い：07898_hakanai⟧: fleeting, ephemeral (an aesthetic concept closely related to {無常|むじょう})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無常|むじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel impermanence
- ⟦{諸行無常|しょぎょうむじょう}→諸行無常：14481_shogyoumujou⟧: all things are impermanent
- {無常|むじょう}{観|かん}: sense of impermanence
